text:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up for the KV-cache OOM on 3/18. Need owners, short timelines, and immediate canary plan.

Aj: I'll run a focused profiler on staging and collect heap snapshots. Repro + tracer for ~20m.

Sara: I'll own GC tuning and a temporary soft limit. Proposal: `kv.soft_limit_pct=72`, `kv.hard_eviction_pct=95` for 72h.

Leo: I'll build the canary rollout (5%->25%->50%) with gates on GC pause and OOM counts.

Priya: I'll add an anomaly job to detect shard growth spikes and auto-tag shards with repeated bursts. Backfill 60d.

Aj: Staging commands:
```
./infra/reserve --pool staging-kv --for 3h --start 1765560000
./tools/replay --from 2026-03-18 --dur 2h --isolate
./kv-profiler --out /tmp/kv.pb --time 20m
```

OpsBot: staging-kv reserved 1765560000-17655610800, owner: infra-team. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Owners & due dates: Aj +2bd, Sara +4bd, Leo +5bd, Priya +7bd. Agree?

Aj: ok. I'll upload profiles to gs://redwood-dev/kv-profiles/1765555555/ after run.

Sara: Draft PR incoming with softlimit + eviction logging and frag_ratio histogram.

Leo: Dashboards will show `kv.resident_bytes`, `kv.evicted_count`, `kv.frag_ratio`, `kv.gc_pause_ms`. I'll template panels.

Priya: Anomaly rule: if frag_ratio spikes or resident_bytes growth > baseline + 3*sigma, alert. If same shard fires 3x in 7d -> create PD ticket.

Maya: Action list posted here. Weekly Friday 10am PT check-ins until resolved. Post one-line status by EOD tomorrow.

Aj: status: replay scheduled, profiler flags ready.

Sara: status: PR draft up, running staging test.

Leo: status: dashboard skeleton created.

Priya: status: anomaly job configured, starting backfill tonight.

Maya: Thanks. Ping me with blockers.

Leo: note: if frag_ratio >0.45 after tuning, consider compaction run.

Sara: adding compaction playbook to PR.

Maya: end.
